correctness.rationale: All exact hitting-time claims independently re-executed and analytically cross-checked. (1) Enumeration completeness: p0 in 4 quarter options, each interior i=1..6 in exactly 6 (p,q,r) triples with p,q>0 multiples of 1/4 (exhaustive pair check: (1/4,1/4),(1/4,1/2),(1/4,3/4),(1/2,1/4),(1/2,1/2),(3/4,1/4)), q7 in 4 options => 4*6^6*4=746496 irreducible chains; periodic iff all r=0 => 1*3^6*1=729, aperiodic 745767. Auditor confirms counts. (2) First-step equations and d-recurrence d0=1/p0, p_i d_i - q_i d_{i-1}=1 verified algebraically; row-7 irrelevance proved since (I-Q)h=1 uses only rows 0..6. (3) P* hand value: d=[4,16,52,160,484,1456,4372] from d_i=4+3d_{i-1} with closed form 2*3^{i+1}-2 sums to 6544; Fraction recursion and Fraction Gauss-Jordan both return 6544/1 (re-ran verify_exact.py: all top-five recur==gauss). (4) Exhaustive exact census re-ran (2.6s): 186624 rows-0..6 patterns, unique max pattern (0,(2,2,2,2,2,2)), 10046 distinct exact values topped by 6544,5088,4608,4464,4358, then 3956,3636,3632,3630,10888/3 — matches DRAFT. Tie census re-ran: 6544x1 pattern (4 full chains), 5088x2, 4608x2, 4464x2 (8 full chains each), 4358x1 (4 chains); symmetric pairs (deviation at 1 vs 6, 2 vs 5, 3 vs 4) confirmed; all max/top reps have r0>0 hence aperiodic. Periodic max re-ran as 3265<6544, so aperiodicity filter does not move argmax. (5) Analytic dominance proof doubly certifies max without computer: for any d_prev>0, (1+q d_prev)/p is maximized by (p,q)=(1/4,3/4) among the 6 options (e.g. at d=4: 16 vs 12,8,6,4,2.66), and d0=1/p0 maximized by p0=1/4; positivity of q_i/p_i propagates monotonicity, so left-drift is unique maximizer mod row 7. (6) Mixing bracket honestly labeled numerical/empirical, not overclaimed: eigenvalues re-ran as 1,0.8678396994,0.71583796,0.445564186,0.0997552436,-0.26184458,-0.5767208769,-0.7904316318, trace 1.5=sum eig, det matches, |lambda*|=0.86784 well separated from 0.7904; stationary pi proportional to (1,1/3,...,1/3^6,1/3^6) verified by detailed balance and normalization to (0.66636,0.22212,0.07404,0.02468,0.00823,0.00274,0.000914,0.000914); lower bound ceil(ln(1/2)/ln|lambda*|)=ceil(4.8899)=5 correct via |lambda|^t<=2d(t); LP numeric upper 7.5666*log(1/(0.25*pi_min))=63.437=>64 correct; coupling re-ran N=20000 seed 20260907: mean 16.89, median 15, P(tau>20)=0.2530, P(tau>30)=0.0639, so empirical t_mix<=21 threshold correct and 4*mean=67.6 consistent. DRAFT Sec.5 explicitly states numpy ~1e-12 error, Monte Carlo not theorem, reversible-form upper numeric — correct separation of proof vs evidence. No correctness defect found.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: nearest priors are (i) Levin-Peres-Wilmer Markov Chains and Mixing Times (general mixing/hitting bounds, spectral-gap and coupling methods, no finite denominator-restricted extremal table, no 8-state quarter-grid maximizer or 6544 value), (ii) Norris Markov Chains (parametric birth-death hitting formula and fundamental-matrix equations used for verification, but no grid restriction or optimization over it), (iii) Aldous-Fill Reversible Markov Chains (general commute/hitting/mixing asymptotics, no small-n small-denominator enumeration with rational certificates). Live web fetches for those URLs and arXiv birth-death extremal queries were attempted by auditor and returned transport errors (no internet, consistent with triage proxy 502/SSL failures), so priority claim is explicitly limited to those canonical texts in DRAFT Sec.7 — no broader literature priority claimed. Internal Resultary scan (7 successes, 17 failures) reviewed: closest success SCOPE002 (lazy walk on balanced spiders with k-L-explicit coupling tail) concerns different graph family and parametric asymptotic bound, not finite-grid census; other successes (synchronizing automata, forbidden families, Kronecker, RSBF, Heilbronn) differ in object/method/claim. No prior table names S_{8,4}, P*, 6544, or top-five 5088/4608/4464/4358 with tie structure. The max pattern itself follows by short monotonicity from the textbook formula (hence obvious in hindsight, noted as value caveat not originality defeat), but the compiled exact distribution (10046 distinct values), paired tie identities (deviation at i vs 7-i giving identical H, e.g. 5088 both early and late), periodic max 3265, and instantiated spectral/coupling bracket for P* are not contained in or implied as stated tables by the general formulas. Therefore the finite-stratum census is narrowly but genuinely new as a compiled record.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a citable MCMC worst-case benchmark, not a textbook restatement or unmotivated enumeration. (a) Not restatement: textbooks supply the parametric recurrence but not the S_{8,4} argmax/value, the 10046-value distribution, the paired-symmetry tie census, or the P*-specific spectral data; top-five ordering (5088 via i=1/6 deviation, 4608 via i=2/5, 4464 via i=3/4, 4358 via p0=1/2) and the identity that early vs late single deviations coincide (e.g. 4+12+40+124+376+1132+3400=5088 equals 4+16+52+160+484+1456+2916) require enumeration and are not obvious from monotonicity alone. (b) Not mere parameter substitution: n=8 denominator-4 stratum is explicitly motivated as a laptop-rerunnable (<1 min) worst-case pair bridging textbook formulas and asymptotic mixing bounds for direct benchmark citation, with fallback top-five catalog; analogous to previously validated finite censuses (8-state automata, 7-variable RSBF, n=12 Kronecker). (c) Not tiny gain or unexplained enumeration: exact max plus full tie census plus periodic-max check plus honestly-caveated mixing bracket with deterministic rerunnable stdlib scripts (exact Fraction solves, Gauss cross-check, float screen, spectral trace/det checks, seeded coupling) provides reusable verification-critical artifacts. DRAFT forthrightly states extremizer unsurprising and mixing bracket subordinate/empirical, avoiding overclaim. A future worker testing hitting-time solvers, mixing estimators, or coupling diagnostics would reuse the explicit matrix, exact fractions, and scripts rather than re-derive.
